objective: Complete a leakage-resistant SUBJECT_GENERALIZATION_V1 six-subject held-out pilot using the locked PAPER_TEXT_V1 architecture and the finalized E-drive SST cache, with independently verifiable fold evidence.
deliverables: Immutable SUBJECT_GENERALIZATION_V1 protocol and fold-selection manifest
Versioned subject-held-out pilot runner with exactly-once fold markers and fail-closed resource and lineage gates
Six independently trained and verified fold artifacts, including subject-disjoint split hashes, checkpoints, metrics, and failure records
Independent read-only review and canonical acceptance gate
Final evidence-backed report separating paper reproduction from subject generalization
nonGoals: Do not alter or reuse r1 through r19 production runs
Do not compare subject-wise metrics directly with the manuscript's epoch-random-split 83 percent result
Do not claim full LOSO or multi-seed generalization from the six-subject pilot
Do not launch training when the live RAM, commit, power, storage, or GPU admission gate is unsafe
Do not download new data or require internet access when the finalized local cache is valid
acceptance: Protocol manifest binds SUBJECT_GENERALIZATION_V1, six deterministic held-out subjects, validation policy, model seed policy, cap 128, the subject-balanced round-robin cap policy, cache hash, source hash, environment hash, and exact run prefix
Every fold has pairwise-disjoint subject sets for train, validation, and test, and its split membership hashes are independently reproducible

Every fold uses the locked PAPER_TEXT_V1 architecture and stage configuration while recording SUBJECT_GENERALIZATION_V1 as the evaluation protocol; the protocol hashes/counts are the exact capped hashes used for execution
Every completed fold has finite metrics, a checkpoint hash, complete stage lineage, trainer TF2.4 identity, and locked TF2.4 standalone verification in a separate process
A failed fold stops later folds and records an immutable failure artifact; no retry, resume, relaunch, or reuse path is available
Independent review reports no unresolved material finding, the canonical gate binds exact evidence hashes, and the final report states pilot limitations

ownership: subject-generalization protocol, runner, focused tests, evidence, gate, and final integration
doneWhen: All required pilot artifacts and acceptance checks are complete or the run is immutably blocked with root cause evidence

ownership: read-only review of the protocol, split leakage controls, runner exact-once behavior, evidence bindings, and final gate
doneWhen: Return an evidence-backed no-material-finding result or specific confirmed findings

decisions: The six-subject pilot is deliberately separate from PAPER_TEXT_V1 epoch-random-split training and is not a numerical replication claim.
The finalized local cache is reused as immutable input; prior r19 child runs remain evidence only and are not used as subject-generalization training checkpoints.
The pilot will use six deterministic subjects selected by a recorded seed, one test subject per fold, and one rotating validation subject; all other subjects are training subjects for that fold.

The per-split cap is 128 selected by sorted subject-balanced round-robin; this keeps all available training subjects represented when the cap permits and binds the resulting capped membership hashes in protocol and execution records.
A full cohort LOSO expansion remains a later phase and is not silently substituted for the six-subject pilot.
